request: Prevent duplicate task creation and UI freezing when creating a task in the local mobile app without changing existing task behavior.
acceptance: Rapid repeated taps on Create produce at most one task.
The Create button is disabled and indicates progress while creation is running.
Task fields, list memberships, assignee behavior, subtasks, and navigation remain unchanged for a successful creation.
Task and draft subtasks are committed atomically in local SQLite.
excluded: Changes to existing-task editing and autosave behavior.
Changes to the local query hook interface.
Remote synchronization, deployment, or public access.
verification: Run workspace platform checks and tests.
Build the Android release artifact when the local build environment is available.
Manually verify new-task creation with rapid taps, lists, assignee, due date, notes, and subtasks.
rollback: Revert this local Git change; the existing SQLite database remains compatible because no schema changes were made.
